 In the Round of 32 at the Toray Pan Pacific Open Tennis on Tuesday, Nikola Bartunkova (ranked No. 29) takes on Aliaksandra Sasnovich (No. 112).
 In this match, Bartunkova is favored (-222) against Sasnovich (+170) .
 Toray Pan Pacific Open Tennis Info 
 Tournament: The Toray Pan Pacific Open Tennis
 Round: Round of 32
 Date: Tuesday, October 27
 Venue: Ariake Coliseum & Ariake Tennis Forest Park
 Location: Ariake, Japan
 Court Surface: Hard
